IC1: Age 18 to 75 years old (male [OR] or female).
IC2: Patients with posterior [OR] or posterolateral disc herniations at one level between L1 and S1 with radiographic confirmation [AND] of neural compression using CT [OR] and/or MRI.
IC3: At least six (6) weeks of failed, conservative treatment [OR] prior to surgery, or requires immediate surgery [AND] to prevent permanent disability.
IC4: Minimum posterior disc height of 5mm at the index level(s).
IC5: Lower back pain [OR] and/or sciatica [AND] with or without spinal claudication.
IC6: Oswestry Questionnaire score of at least 40/100 at baseline.
IC7: VAS leg pain of at least 40/100 at baseline.
IC8: Psychosocially, mentally and physically able to fully comply with the clinical protocol and willing to adhere to follow-up schedule and requirements.
